**Security: pass-with-notes** at `b673b71012a862e1638c467bb520e816f587e4fe`.

No reportable security vulnerability found in the `011eb97..b673b71` receipt/retry repair and relevant merge resolutions. Earlier fixed-label, framing and canary limitations stand.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No reportable vulnerability | N/A |

Tell acceptance uses structured outcomes, not rendered prefixes (`crates/daemon/src/modal_stall.rs:287`). Delivered, including replay, Queued and Held mark acceptance; Refused/errors remain bounded retry failures. Held retains human approval, not authority to approve or execute.

Successful receipt rendering uses constant outcome words (`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:375`). Genuine errors may remain in audit/log strings, but do not become notification bodies or row labels. The new error paths receive store/receipt errors, not captured-screen bytes. Fixed marker labels remain the sole production label source; no new raw-text fallback was found.

Attempt admission precedes delivery (`crates/daemon/src/modal_stall.rs:241`). Failed counter persistence or a different stretch sends nothing. Storage records recipient IDs/counts with bound SQL, not receipt diagnostics or capture text (`crates/store/src/stalls.rs:99`). Cancellation after admission may consume an attempt without sending; it cannot bypass admission.

No new clearing-key path; notifications retain `command: None`. Migration 42 and the decoder use `attempts` consistently. This is not live-schema migration proof.

The native-incarnation refusal/recovery test checks parent-only retry with the same message ID and no repeated PA notification. The counter-abort test checks no sends for `MAX_TELL_TRIES + 2` rounds and delivery after dropping the trigger. Both were source-reviewed.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42395277193](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42395277193), attempt 1, passed all four jobs. JUnit lists 2,143 passing cases, including both new regressions and the retained privacy canary. No repair-owned C19/C21 disclosure found. Source/CI review only: no local builds/tests, probes, credential reads or product edits. Full correctness/cost assessments remain separately owned.
